name: manual_ec11f1
claim: When a content checker flags a file your grep says is clean, replicate the checker's EXACT matching before concluding false-positive — it may lowercase (case-insensitive). Also: content guards scan COMMENTS too, so stale config comments with banned IDs trip them; keep config comments current.

decisions.notes: 2026-06-22: check_no_hallucinated_models lowercases text, so it caught 'Qwen3-Coder-14B' in a config/models.yml comment that a case-sensitive grep missed.
